tour.ui.click_hint: Click it to go on, or press Next.
tour.ui.list_help: A short guided walk through the tablet. Start one any time; Escape ends it.
tour.ui.state.queued: Shows on your next mission run
tour.officer.welcome.title: Welcome to your police tablet
tour.officer.welcome.body: This short tour shows where everything is. Use Next and Back, or the arrow keys. Escape ends it at any time.
tour.officer.status.title: Your status
tour.officer.status.body: The tablet works while you are on duty with your police job. This card says whether you are ready for a mission and what to work on next.
tour.officer.board.title: Mission Board
tour.officer.board.body: Every mission type you can take today is on the Mission Board. Click it to open it.
tour.officer.accept.title: Accept a mission
tour.officer.accept.body: Pick a type and press Accept. You get a mission of that type and a route to its start. Nothing starts until you press it.
tour.officer.active.title: Active Mission
tour.officer.active.body: While you are on a mission, Active Mission shows the objectives, the time left and the people with you.
tour.officer.unit.title: Unit
tour.officer.unit.body: Invite other officers into your unit to take missions together. A ready check asks everyone before the run starts.
tour.officer.dispatch.title: Dispatch
tour.officer.dispatch.body: Mission calls for your department come in here. Claim one to take it.
tour.officer.me.title: Me
tour.officer.me.body: Your profile, run history, the leaderboard and the department challenge.
tour.officer.options.title: My options
tour.officer.options.body: Set the tablet up for yourself: the HUD, pop-ups, sounds and keys. The Tours card there replays this tour.
tour.officer.help.title: Help any time
tour.officer.help.body: The ? button replays this tour on any screen.
tour.supervisor.welcome.title: Welcome to the Supervisor UI
tour.supervisor.welcome.body: This short tour shows the tools you have as a supervisor. Use Next and Back, or the arrow keys. Escape ends it at any time.
tour.supervisor.today.title: Today
tour.supervisor.today.body: Officers on duty, runs going, runs waiting for review and the controls you used today. Click a tile to open it.
tour.supervisor.officers.title: Officers
tour.supervisor.officers.body: Your department's officers. Click one to open the side panel with their runs and the actions you may take.
tour.supervisor.controls.title: Controls
tour.supervisor.controls.body: Mission controls such as cooldowns and happy hour. Each control shows the limits an admin set and how much of it you used today.
tour.supervisor.review.title: Review
tour.supervisor.review.body: Runs that need a supervisor's look: approve them, or void them with a reason.
tour.supervisor.calls.title: Calls and notices
tour.supervisor.calls.body: The mission calls of your department and the notices your officers see.
tour.supervisor.training.title: Field training
tour.supervisor.training.body: Pair a new officer with a trainer and sign off each mission type they learned.
tour.supervisor.help.title: Help any time
tour.supervisor.help.body: The ? button replays this tour on any screen.
tour.admin.welcome.title: Welcome to the Admin UI
tour.admin.welcome.body: This short tour shows how the Admin UI is laid out. Use Next and Back, or the arrow keys. Escape ends it at any time.
tour.admin.home.title: Home
tour.admin.home.body: Home is the dashboard: who is on duty, the runs going, what waits for you and your shortcuts.
tour.admin.checklist.title: Setup checklist
tour.admin.checklist.body: What a new city still has to do. Each line ticks itself once the server sees it done; click one to open the screen that fixes it.
tour.admin.search.title: Search
tour.admin.search.body: Find any screen, tab, officer, mission or setting. Ctrl+K puts the cursor here from anywhere.
tour.admin.groups.title: The groups
tour.admin.groups.body: Every screen sits in a group by job: People, Missions, Real players, Money, Review and System, with the rare tools under More.
tour.admin.gear.title: This screen's settings
tour.admin.gear.body: The gear opens only the settings of the screen you are on.
tour.admin.presets.title: Presets
tour.admin.presets.body: A preset sets a group of settings in one click, after a preview of every change. Go-live turns Debug and the test tools off.
tour.admin.money.title: Money
tour.admin.money.body: Pay per mission type, rewards, payments made and department funds.
tour.admin.locks.title: Money tools and ENABLE
tour.admin.locks.body: Features turns whole features on or off. The money tools ship off: turning one on asks you to type ENABLE, and every change is logged.
tour.admin.help.title: Help any time
tour.admin.help.body: The ? button replays this tour, and Settings -> Tours lists it too.
tour.criminal.welcome.title: Welcome to the criminal tablet
tour.criminal.welcome.body: This short tour shows how to play a suspect for real officers. Use Next and Back, or the arrow keys. Escape ends it at any time.
tour.criminal.optin.title: Opt in
tour.criminal.optin.body: Pick the roles you want, agree to the rules and press the button to be listed for a while. You can stop at any time.
tour.criminal.jobs.title: Jobs
tour.criminal.jobs.body: While you are listed, the jobs offered to you show here.
tour.criminal.consent.title: You always say yes first
tour.criminal.consent.body: Each job asks you first and shows the area, the travel time and the reward. Nothing starts until you press Accept.
tour.criminal.rules.title: Rules
tour.criminal.rules.body: How long you stay listed, how long you have to answer and travel, and what counts as a strike.
tour.criminal.strikes.title: Strikes and history
tour.criminal.strikes.body: Leaving a job you accepted gives a strike. Too many strikes block you for a while. Your past cases are listed here too.
tour.criminal.help.title: Help any time
admin.setup.tour: Show me around the Admin UI when I finish
admin.checklist.title: Setup checklist
admin.checklist.left: {n} left to do before going live
admin.checklist.departments: Departments use your Qbox police jobs
admin.checklist.departments_hint: At least one department whose jobs all exist in Qbox (Departments).
admin.checklist.grades_hint: Each department's supervisor grade is a real grade above its lowest one (Departments).
admin.checklist.desks_hint: At least one desk, or desks are turned off as a way to open the tablet (Departments -> Desks).
admin.checklist.storage_hint: You are on the saves folder until Config.Database.enabled is on and oxmysql runs (Server health).
admin.checklist.scripts_hint: Every script you named for dispatch, ambulance, banking and police is running (Server health).
admin.checklist.money_hint: The money tools ship off. Turn on the ones you want with ENABLE (Settings -> Features).
admin.checklist.presets_hint: Apply Casual, Serious RP or Go-live once (Settings -> Presets).
admin.checklist.debug_hint: Debug prints extra console lines; turn it off before players join (Settings).
ui.admin_officers.confirm.resetTours: Show every guided tour to this character again
err.training_off: Guided tours are switched off on this server.
err.training_unknown: There is no tour with that name. Try officer, supervisor, admin, criminal or run.
err.training_not_yours: That tour is not for your role. Type /crimsonhelp on its own to get yours.
err.training_none: There is no tour for you right now. Go on duty with a police job, or open the criminal tablet first.
err.training_not_loaded: Your character is not loaded yet. Try again in a moment.
tour.run.hud.title: Your mission HUD
tour.run.hud.body: While a mission runs, this card at the edge of the screen shows the mission, its tier and the time left. It needs no clicks.
tour.run.objectives.title: Objectives
tour.run.objectives.body: Do the objectives from the top. The one to do now is marked, and a tick shows each one done.
tour.run.gps.title: Follow the GPS
tour.run.gps.body: This line says where to go and how far it is. Your map waypoint leads there; stay on the route when the line asks you to.
tour.run.result.title: Your result
tour.run.result.body: When the run ends, this card shows your points, pay and any bonus. Your run history is under Me on the tablet.
tour.ui.run_next: The first run tips show beside the HUD on your next mission run.
